purpose: Isolate explicit geometric matching supervision while preserving the v5 deployed architecture

geometry.feature_centres: (4*x,4*y) in 64x48 images, matching two k3 stride2 padding1 convolutions
geometry.mapping: current camera-z depth, intrinsics and labeled relative pose map current points into previous image
geometry.offsets: previous-minus-current in feature cells, x/y each in [-1,1]; row-major dy then dx
geometry.soft_targets: bilinear mass over 9 lattice offsets, preserving subpixel location
geometry.mask: fixed original GT visibility AND positive depths AND finite/in-window displacement AND full 3x3 grid support
geometry.mask_policy: exclude invalid/occluded/out-of-window points; no predicted confidence or masks
geometry.depth_approximation: reuse recorded low-resolution point-sampled depth and its known 0.05 pixel sampling offset

training.optimizer: fresh Adam on existing encoder/rotation head only; translation base frozen
training.rotation_loss: unchanged SmoothL1 calibrated residual divided by 0.01 rad
training.matching_loss: equal usable-pair soft-label cross entropy of local correlations / temperature
training.data: 2388 original train pairs scenes2/3/4, 796 original validation pairs scenes5/6; public scene1 excluded
training.checkpoint: lowest equal-episode accumulated validation rotation RMSE among trained epochs1..40; earlier on ties; preserve epoch0 separately

matching_evaluation.metric: soft-argmax endpoint error in 64x48 image pixels; equal valid points within each episode then equal episodes
matching_evaluation.note: Measure all-valid and moving-subset EPE; small-displacement/zero-predictor baselines prevent trivial centre-match claims

acceptance.reference: preserved calibrated-gyro zero-correction reference, consistent with v5 eligibility
acceptance.explicit_matching_required: at least 5% lower validation EPE than starting v5 temporal AND matched continuation on both all-valid and moving subsets
acceptance.otherwise: retain previous choices; compare trained candidates as diagnostics

timing: serial complete WASM runs after training; use exact preserved artifacts for old references
budget: two fixed 40-epoch CPU fits and seven serial public runs; no search or paid compute
